recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-key portrait of a man in Western formal attire seated in a dimly lit, upscale bar environment. The scene features a high-contrast interplay between deep shadows and warm highlights, focusing on the texture of the pinstripe suit and the reflective surfaces of the wooden table and glassware.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright white cowboy hat acts as the primary focal point against the dark background.
The diagonal line of the man's pinstripe suit leads the eye toward the glass on the table.
The warm amber tones of the drink and table contrast with the cool blue-grey of the suit and jeans.
The text is anchored to the bottom third, overlapping the subject's legs and the table edge.
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting with a strong key light from the side.
Presence of a wide-brimmed Western hat.
A dark, out-of-focus background suggesting an interior lounge or bar.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white cowboy hat at the top and the large serif typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the hat, moves down the face and suit to the hands, then follows the table edge to the glass and finally to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark negative space in the upper right and background to create depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the hat and shirt providing high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Amber and red tones in the drink, table wood, and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation overall with high value contrast between the hat and the surrounding shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant primary colors.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with thin serifs.
Large, all-caps display for the primary name.
Lowercase, tighter-spaced serif for the secondary title.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the primary text has a deep, rounded descender that drops below the baseline.

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast between two weights of the same or similar serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and elegant serifs match the formal Western aesthetic.
Classic feel for the secondary lowercase text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a mustache wearing a white cowboy hat and a navy pinstripe suit jacket over a white shirt. He is sitting at a dark wooden table in a dimly lit bar. A glass of whiskey is on the table. Use low-key lighting with warm highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in large, white, all-caps high-contrast serif font across the bottom third. Below it, add the title in a smaller, muted red, lowercase serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the cowboy hat the brightest element in the top half?
Is the primary text in all-caps serif?
Is the secondary text in a contrasting red/terracotta color?
Does the lighting create a moody, lounge-like atmosphere?

adjustableVariables: Color of the secondary text (red vs amber)
Subject's pose (looking down vs looking at camera)
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos or specific album titles.

mustAchieve: Balanced use of warm and cool tones

postGenerationChecks: Check for legibility of the red text against the dark background.
Ensure the hat does not appear blown out or lose detail.
Verify the pinstripes are sharp and not moiré-distorted.
Confirm the 'J' descender style in the primary text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Western Formal Subject] with [Low-Key Bar Lighting] and [Classical High-Contrast Serif Typography] anchored at the base.
